title: Site Supervisor
description:
We are seeking a skilled and experienced Site Supervisor to join our team. The Site Supervisor will play a crucial role in overseeing the construction process, ensuring that projects are completed on time, within budget, and to the highest quality standards. This role requires strong leadership abilities, excellent communication skills, and a keen attention to detail.

**Responsibilities:**

\- Manage on\-site construction activities to ensure adherence to design specifications, timelines, and budget constraints.

\- Collaborate with architects, interior designers, and contractors to resolve any design or construction issues that may arise during the project.

\- Conduct regular site inspections to monitor progress, quality of workmanship, and compliance with safety regulations.

\- Review and interpret architectural drawings, plans, and specifications to guide construction activities.

\- Coordinate with suppliers, subcontractors, and vendors to procure materials and equipment as needed.

\- Document project progress, including daily reports, photographs, and as\-built drawings.

\- Communicate effectively with clients to address concerns, provide updates, and obtain approvals as required.

**Requirements:**

\- Bachelor’s degree in Architecture, Interior Design, or related field.

\- Proven experience of 2\-5 years in site supervision or construction management within the architectural or interior design industry.

\- Strong knowledge of construction techniques, building codes, and regulations.

\- Proficiency in reading and interpreting architectural drawings and blueprints.

\- Excellent communication, leadership, and problem\-solving skills.

\- Ability to work independently and collaboratively in a fast\-paced environment.

\- Proficiency in relevant software and tools.

\- Detail\-oriented mindset with a focus on quality and precision.

\- Effective communication skills, both verbal and written.

\- Ability to work independently and make decisions confidently.

\- Proficiency in relevant software and tools for project management and documentation.

**Benefits:**

\- Competitive salary commensurate with experience.

\- Opportunities for career growth and professional development.

\- Collaborative and supportive work environment with a diverse team of professionals.

\- Chance to contribute to exciting and innovative architectural projects that make a difference in communities.

title: Technical Architect
company: HiringPulse – A Company of VDOIT Technologies Limited
description:
**About the Role**

Vdoit is looking for an experienced and hands\-on **Technical Architect – AI** to lead the design and implementation of scalable, secure, and high\-performance technology solutions.

The ideal candidate will have strong expertise in **AI/ML, Generative AI, software architecture, cloud technologies, system design, APIs, microservices, and modern application development**. The candidate will work closely with engineering, product, DevOps, and business teams to translate business requirements into robust technical solutions.

**Key Responsibilities**

* Design and define scalable, secure, and high\-performance application architectures.
* Lead technical architecture and solution design for new and existing products.
* Evaluate and implement **AI/ML and Generative AI** capabilities into business applications.
* Design AI solutions using **LLMs, RAG, embeddings, vector databases, AI APIs, and prompt engineering**.
* Work closely with product managers, developers, DevOps teams, and business stakeholders to understand requirements and define technical solutions.
* Create architecture documents, technical specifications, system diagrams, and technology roadmaps.
* Define and enforce best practices related to coding, architecture, security, scalability, performance, and maintainability.
* Design and integrate **REST APIs, microservices, third\-party APIs, and cloud services**.
* Identify technical risks and recommend appropriate architectural solutions.
* Conduct technical reviews and mentor senior developers and engineering teams.
* Research emerging technologies and recommend tools and frameworks suitable for Vdoit's technology ecosystem.
* Ensure solutions are scalable, maintainable, secure, reliable, and cost\-effective.
* Troubleshoot complex technical and architectural challenges and provide long\-term solutions.

**Required Technical Skills**

* **5–10 years of experience** in software development, solution architecture, or technical architecture.
* Strong understanding of **System Design and Software Architecture**.
* Hands\-on experience with one or more programming languages such as **Python, Java, Node.js, .NET, or similar**.
* Strong understanding of **AI/ML and Generative AI** concepts.
* Hands\-on experience with **LLMs, OpenAI/Gemini/Claude or similar AI APIs, RAG, embeddings, vector databases, and prompt engineering**.
* Strong knowledge of **REST APIs, microservices, event\-driven architecture, and distributed systems**.
* Experience with cloud platforms such as **AWS, Azure, or Google Cloud**.
* Good knowledge of databases such as **PostgreSQL, MySQL, MongoDB, Redis**, or equivalent.
* Understanding of **Docker, Kubernetes, CI/CD, Git, and DevOps practices**.
* Strong understanding of **application security, authentication, authorization, and data protection**.
* Experience integrating third\-party services and APIs.

**Good to Have**

* Experience building **AI\-powered enterprise applications**.
* Experience with **LangChain, LlamaIndex, Hugging Face, vector databases**, or similar AI frameworks.
* Knowledge of **AWS Bedrock, Azure OpenAI, Google Vertex AI**, or equivalent AI platforms.
* Experience with **AI agents, tool calling, function calling, or multi\-agent architectures**.
* Experience designing **high\-availability and highly scalable systems**.
* Knowledge of **cloud\-native and serverless architectures**.
* Experience working in **Agile/Scrum** environments.

**Soft Skills**

* Strong analytical and problem\-solving abilities.
* Excellent communication and stakeholder\-management skills.
* Ability to explain complex technical concepts to technical and non\-technical audiences.
* Strong leadership, collaboration, and mentoring capabilities.
* Ability to take ownership of architecture and technical decisions.
* Strong interest in emerging technologies, particularly **AI and Generative AI**.

**Education**

* Bachelor's/Master's degree in **Computer Science, Information Technology, Engineering**, or a related field is preferred.

**What We Offer**

* Opportunity to work on **AI\-driven and next\-generation technology solutions**.
* Exposure to modern **cloud, software architecture, and Generative AI technologies**.
* Opportunity to work with a collaborative and innovative technology team.
* Career growth and leadership opportunities.

Pay: ₹1,000,000\.00 \- ₹1,200,000\.00 per year

Benefits:

* Paid time off
* Provident Fund
